::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 220,826 people lived in County Meath, up 13.2% on 2016. It had the 5th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 120% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Meath was €1,542, the 6th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Meath

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Meath was €26,575, the 19th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Meath was €417,200, the 4th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 9.7 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Meath, the second highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 20% of households in County Meath rented their home, the lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 18% of people living in County Meath were born outside Ireland, the 12th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 40% of people aged 3 and over in County Meath said they could speak Irish, the 15th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 35% of people at work in County Meath worked from home for at least part of the week, the 5th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 76% of people travelling to work in County Meath went by car, the 14th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Meath live more than 2.1 km by road from a GP, the 15th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Meath live more than 14.1 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 22nd furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 3.7% of County Meath in 2021, the lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
